versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.7

- Added hooks.md file to the project.
- Updated required file paths in metadata to include /workspace/content/hooks.md for both reading and writing.
- No other structural or behavior changes.

- Updates network behavior: direct Telegram notifications are no longer sent by the skill; notification duties are now handled by the agent’s core integration.
- Clarifies in the metadata that this skill performs only filesystem operations (read/write), with content written to the queue for publishing.
- Adjusts metadata fields: sets `uses_agent_telegram` to false and adds a note explaining the new workflow.
- No changes to files or core logic—documentation and metadata only.

No file changes detected in this release.

- No modifications or updates were made to the skill files.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged from the previous version.

content-creator-pro 1.0.4

- Added content_tracker.py for enhanced content tracking and management.
- Introduced ERRORS.md for error logging and documentation.
- Added performance.json to monitor and track content performance.
- Added calendar.json for content scheduling.
- Added voice.md to further standardize and capture brand voice across outputs.

Version 1.0.3 Changelog

- Updated Telegram integration: no longer makes external requests; now only triggers internal agent notifications.
- Clarified Telegram usage in metadata (notifies on content review, weekly summaries, viral alerts).
- Removed network request targeting of Telegram Bot API from metadata.
- No file or functional changes to the core content creation engine.

- Renamed skill from "content-creator" to "content-creator-pro" to reflect enhanced functionalities.
- Updated skill description for improved clarity and to better outline use cases and triggers.
- Minor metadata adjustments for consistency and alignment with skill purpose.
- No functional or code changes in this version.

**Changelog for content-creator-pro v1.0.1**

- Updated network behavior: now explicitly declares requests to https://api.telegram.org (Telegram Bot API).
- "makes_requests" field set to true, clarifying actual network operation.
- No code or functionality changes detected beyond metadata updates for network permissions.

- Major update: Content-creator relaunched as a human-centric, autonomous content creation engine—no longer a redirect skill.
- Writes high-quality, platform-native content (posts, threads, newsletters, long-form) that avoids detectable AI writing patterns.
- Integrates advanced anti-AI-pattern system, prioritizing unpredictability, rhythm variation, structural diversity, and authentic human voice.
- Implements hook mastery system for compelling starts across formats and audiences.
- Tracks content performance, learns from outcomes, and continuously adapts strategy and style.
- Requires supporting skills (agent-shark-mindset, acquisition-master) and integrates with Telegram for notifications or feedback.
